text_block_list.text:
You have been liberated from your narrow cage!
A fine wine of celebration is fitting for this encounter!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you have my thanks! Controlling that iron arm
and pulling the strings of fate... truly skillful work.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuhahahahahaha!!
You certainly know how to intoxicate me!
